main_text.p: לְבַדִּי Solus ego, לְבַדְּךָ Solus tu, לְבַדּוֹ Solus ipse, לְבַדְּכֶם Soli vos, &c.

בָּדַל Hiph. הִבְדִּיל Separavit, Disparavit, Distinxit, Distinctione fecit, Discrevit: Praet. הִבְדִּיל Separavit; Num.16.9. &c. Hoph. Pari. praet. sive Pahul הָבְדָּלוֹת Separata, Iesa.16.9. pro מְבֻדָּלוֹת juxta R.Sal. Et Kimchi in Com. inquit; Chirek esse loco Schurek, quod scil. cum Kametz chatuph in ea conjugatione permutatur. Niph. נִבְדַּל Separari, Separare se: Praet. נִבְדְּלוּ Separaverunt se, Esr.9.1. Partic. הִנִּבְדָּל Separatus, Esr.6.21.
בָּדָל m. Segmentum, Particula separata: בְּדַל הָאֹזֶן Particulam auris, Amos 3.12.
בְּדִיל m. Stannum, Ezech.27.12. Plur. cum Aff. בְּדִילֶיךָ Stanna tua, Iesa.1.25.

בְּדֹלַח m. Bdellion, Gen.2.12. Num.11.7. Iuxta quosdam Ligni vel arboris nomen; de qua Plinius lib.12. cap.9. & Dioscorides lib.1. Bdolchon, & corrupte Bolchon appellat. Hebraei communiter Crystallum explicant, ut R.Sal. in lib. Num. & Kimchi Iesa.3.19.
בָּרַק Inquisivit, Rimatus, Scrutatus est: Infinit. לִבְרוֹק וּלְחַזֵּק הַבַּיִת Ad scrutandum & restaurandum domum, 2.Par.34.10.
בָּרֵק m. Rima, Fissura, Ruptura, 2.Reg.12.6. Aff. מְחַזְּקֵי בִּרְקֵךְ Restaurantes ruptura tuam, Ezech.27.9.
בָּהַר Chald. in Pahel, Sparsit, Dispersit: Imperat. וּבַדְּרוּ Et spargite, Dan.4.11. Ex Hebraeo בֵּזַר, commutato ז in ד.
בָּהוּ m. Inanitas, Res inanis, Genes.1.v.2. אֲבְנֵי בָּהוּ Perpendicula inanitatis sive inania, Iesa.34.11.
בַּהַט m. Porphyrites, Marmoris species rubens, Esth.1. v.4. Variant interpretes.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and several Latin abbreviations in the small type are hard to read at this scan resolution, so the Hebrew forms, especially the large headwords (בָּדַל, בָּרַק, בָּהַר, בָּהוּ, בַּהַט) and the Hebrew in the Chaldee entry, may contain errors in their points. The running head and the catchword are also uncertain in their Hebrew vowels and letters. The first line is a continuation of the previous entry on this page. The printed "Restaurantes ruptura tuam" appears as shown.
